Description
These commands allow you to display and modify Stats information.
Command List
STATS::get
- Retrieves a setting value from
a Statistics profile.
STATS::incr
- Increments the value of a
Statistics profile setting.
STATS::set
- Sets the value of a Statistics
profile setting.
STATS::setmax
- Ensures that the value of
the specified Statistics profile setting (field) is at the least
value.
STATS::setmin
- Ensures that the value of
the specified Statistics profile setting (field) is at the most
value.
